sentences.text: The issue rather turns on the question of quantum of compensation.
Section 7 of the Act deals with determination of compensation.

Section 7(2) of the Act is as follows :
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (2)Where the amount has been determined by agreement between the Government and the person to whom the amount has to be paid, it shall be pain in accordance with such agreement.
4.In this case, admittedly, there is no such agreement between the parties.
It cannot be the case of the respondents that the land was acquired through private negotiation.
If it was so, there should have been consensus between the parties.
There is no such agreement produced before this Court.
Hence, the District Collector should have determined the compensation payable as per the statutory norms.

Section 7(5) of the Act reads as follows :
(5)Before finally determining the amount, the Collector shall given an opportunity to every person to whom the amount has to be paid to state his case as to the amount.
In this case, I wanted to know if the District Collector had given such opportunity to the temple.
During the relevant time, fit persons had been appointed for the temple.
The issue is not one between the acquiring department and the HR & CE Department.
The trust board or the fit person in charge of the temple ought to be fully associated in the process of determining compensation.
In this case, the temple was not allowed to state its case regarding quantum of compensation.
On this sole ground, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis impugned proceedings are set aside.
The District Collector, Madurai District shall hold an enquiry afresh.
The District Collector shall pass an award under Section 7(3) of the Act and also disburse compensation within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
The petitioner temple can receive the award amount as determined by the District Collector without prejudice to their right to seek enhancement of compensation.
5.This writ petition is allowed on these terms.
No costs.
Connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
